description: Tell a borrower whether refinancing is worth it. Compares their current rate against the best real market offer and returns monthly savings, lifetime savings, and break-even months. Use for 'should I refinance?' questions.

closing_costs.description: Lender fees / closing costs in dollars (default 0)

term_months.description: Remaining or new term in months

name: refinance_break_even

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs filled in because the caller did not supply them; the break-even is only as good as these.

closing_costs.description: Closing costs in dollars assumed because the caller did not supply them.

term_months.description: Loan term in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

best_lender.description: Credit union publishing that best market rate.

best_market_rate.description: Best live published rate available for this product and state, as a percent string.

break_even_months.description: Months of savings needed to repay the closing costs. Refinancing only pays off if the borrower keeps the loan longer than this.

closing_costs.description: Assumed cost in dollars to close the refinance, as a formatted string.

current_monthly_payment.description: Principal-and-interest payment in dollars on the existing loan, as a formatted string.

current_rate.description: The borrower's existing rate as a percent string.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

lifetime_savings.description: Total interest saved in dollars over the full term, before subtracting closing costs.

monthly_savings.description: Reduction in the monthly payment in dollars; the difference between the two payments above.

net_lifetime_savings.description: Lifetime savings after subtracting closing costs — the honest headline number.

new_monthly_payment.description: Principal-and-interest payment in dollars after refinancing at the best market rate.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

reason.description: Why refinancing is not worth it, present only when `refinance_worth_it` is false — e.g. 'No qualifying market offer beats the current rate.' Its absence means a viable refinance was found.

refinance_worth_it.description: True when the refinance clears its costs on the assumptions shown; it does not account for how long the borrower actually plans to stay.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.
